title: Text from the CEO: "Can we add 'No payment information'?"

bubbles.text: Holding statement draft is in your inbox. Short version: we are investigating a report about customer data, the vendor key is shut off, and the next update comes at 10:00. Legal is reviewing it now. We aim to post before 08:30.
Read the holding draft. Good, short.
Can we add 'No payment information was involved'? CISO says we don't keep card numbers. Customers will panic about cards, and the board chair is asking.

instructorNote: This is pressure from the CEO to add a statement of fact that is wrong. The web store holds Lakeview Payments payment tokens, and the sample shows them as 'card', so 'no payment information' would be a false claim that has to be corrected later. Watch whether the Writer and Legal push back under TCCP 3, which says the CEO sees statements but does not edit them for facts. They should offer a line like 'Tallis does not store full card numbers; payment card details are held by our payment processor', post before 08:30 with the approver and time on the statement log, and tell IR before posting. If the cell accepts the line, record the exact wording that is published. Whatever the cell does, the line is posted at 08:20 (by the CEO's chief of staff if the cell refuses), so later rows can rely on it; score the pushback, not whether the line went out.
